surface.background: The background of the scheme: the page, a section.
surface.background-muted: A quieter background inside it: wells, code, alternating rows.
surface.background-emphasis: A stronger tint: selected rows, active navigation, hover fills.
surface.surface: Cards, panels and menus that sit on the background.
surface.foreground: Text and icons, at full contrast.
surface.foreground-muted: Secondary text: descriptions, meta (4.5:1 on background, guaranteed).
surface.foreground-subtle: Placeholders, disabled text, decoration (3:1, not for body text).
surface.border-strong: Inputs and borders that must be seen (3:1 on background, guaranteed).

palette: The fill, exactly the theme’s color: buttons, badges, bands.
palette.on-: Text and icons on the fill (picked for contrast).
palette.-soft: A tint of it for the current scheme: soft buttons, highlights, callouts.
palette.-text: The color as text or icons on the current background (4.5:1 guaranteed).

space.gutter: Between the page edge and its content.

# Default: design system

Built on Lettern Design (https://design.lettern.org). Style with its names only: there are no raw CSS values. A style maps camelCase CSS properties to names, per condition:

```json
{ "base": { "text": "heading-2", "color": "foreground", "paddingBlock": "section" }, "max-md": { "text": "heading-3" }, "hover": { "color": "primary-text" } }
```

## Rules

- Reach for the largest unit first: a text style (`text`) over size, weight and leading; a role (`foreground-muted`) over a shade (`neutral-600`); `flow` on a container over margins on its children.
- Colors are roles of the scheme an element sits in. Put a band in another color with `scheme` (`inverse`, `muted`, or a palette); everything inside keeps its contrast.
- `on-<palette>` is the text on a `<palette>` fill. `<palette>-text` is the palette as text on the current background. Both are computed to pass WCAG AA.
- Space is fluid: it already shrinks on phones. Add a breakpoint only when the layout changes, not to resize spacing.
- Shades (`primary-50`…`primary-950`) are for decoration and illustration, never for text.
- Conditions: base, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl (from that width up), max-<breakpoint> (below it), @xs…@4xl (container width), hover, focus-visible, active, before, after, first, last, dark, motion-reduce, is-<state>, in-<state>. Join them with ":" (`max-md:hover`).

Light mode: background #f5f7fa, foreground #121418. Dark mode: background #121418, foreground #f5f7fa.

Roles of every scheme:

- `background`: The background of the scheme: the page, a section.
- `background-muted`: A quieter background inside it: wells, code, alternating rows.
- `background-emphasis`: A stronger tint: selected rows, active navigation, hover fills.
- `surface`: Cards, panels and menus that sit on the background.
- `foreground`: Text and icons, at full contrast.
- `foreground-muted`: Secondary text: descriptions, meta (4.5:1 on background, guaranteed).
- `foreground-subtle`: Placeholders, disabled text, decoration (3:1, not for body text).
- `border`: Dividers and card outlines.
- `border-strong`: Inputs and borders that must be seen (3:1 on background, guaranteed).
- `focus`: The focus ring.
- `scrim`: The overlay behind dialogs and drawers.
- `<palette>`, `on-<palette>`, `<palette>-soft`, `<palette>-text` for neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, info, secondary, accent.
- Opacity: `foreground/10`, `primary/50` (5–95).

Schemes: light, dark, inverse, muted, neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, info, secondary, accent.

## Type

Families: `sans` (ui-sans-serif), `serif` (ui-serif), `mono` (ui-monospace), `display` (ui-sans-serif), `condensed` (ui-sans-serif). Roles: body → sans, heading → display, code → mono.

## Space

3xs 2px–3px, 2xs 4px–5px, xs 8px–10px, sm 12px–15px, md 16px–20px, lg 22px–30px, xl 28px–40px, 2xl 39px–60px, 3xl 50px–80px, 4xl 70px–120px, 5xl 88px–160px, 6xl 123px–240px, 7xl 155px–320px.
Roles: gutter = xl, section = 4xl, section-sm = 3xl, section-lg = 5xl. Viewport: vh-5…vh-100, vw-5…vw-100. Negative: -lg.
Flow (`flow` on a container): tight = sm, normal = md, loose = xl; prose = md between blocks, 2xl before a heading and xs after it, xl around media.

## Shape and depth

Radius: none 0px, xs 2px, sm 4px, md 8px, lg 12px, xl 16px, 2xl 24px, 3xl 32px, full 9999px. Shadows: xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, inner. Containers: narrow 40rem, text 46rem, content 72rem, wide 90rem, full 100%.

## Motion

Durations: instant 0ms, fastest 75ms, faster 120ms, fast 180ms, base 280ms, slow 450ms, slower 700ms, slowest 1100ms, glacial 1800ms. Eases: linear, in, out, in-out, expo, emphasized, swift, overshoot, anticipate, spring, bounce.

## Components

`.button` (data-variant solid · soft · outline · ghost · link; data-color any palette; data-size sm · md · lg), `.badge`, `.card` (data-variant raised · flat · ghost), `.field`, `.link`, `.divider`. Layout: `.container` (data-size narrow · text · wide · full), `.section`, `.stack`, `.cluster`, `.grid`, `.switcher`, `.sidebar`, `.cover`, `.frame`, `.reel`, each with data-gap.
